title: Release state
description: What `pip install reward-lens` actually gets today, and what exists but is unreleased. Generated by scripts/gen-release.mjs at build time from the package index for `latest` and from the working tree's own pyproject.toml version for `unpublished`. NOT from repository tags: the v3.0.0 tag exists only in the local working tree and the public remote's newest tag is v2.0.1, so tags give a different answer on CI than on a developer's machine. See GROUND-TRUTH.md C-17. Consumed by components/install-strip and components/version-chip. If this file is missing, or the index fetch fails, the build fails: the install strip must never render a placeholder or a cached version.

latest.description: The newest version on the package index. This is what the install command installs. Read from the index, never from pyproject.toml, because pyproject.toml describes the working tree and not what a user gets.

unpublished.description: The version tagged in the repository that is not on the package index, or null when the index is current. RENAMED from `rc` and RE-PATTERNED at build time: the field previously required an `rc|a|b` suffix, which 3.0.0 does not have and cannot be made to have. The repository is tagged v3.0.0 and the index serves 2.0.1, so the old pattern rejected the only value this field will ever hold. The optional suffix group is retained so a genuine future release candidate still validates. See GROUND-TRUTH.md C-1 and DECISIONS.md D-25. When null, the install strip's version row shows only `installs {latest}` and no second clause, and no copy changes.

unpublishedIsAhead.description: True when `unpublished` describes capabilities `latest` does not have. When true, any page describing a capability only present in the unpublished version must carry a version chip. Derived by comparing the two versions, never asserted.

urls.description: The URLs the package index currently publishes. Recorded so a mismatch against copy.yaml:urls is visible rather than silently propagated: at the time of writing the index publishes a documentation host that does not resolve and a personal-fork homepage. See DECISIONS.md D-06.

publishedUrlsAreStale.description: True when the published URLs differ from the canonical ones. When true, the site does not link the package index page as documentation.
